verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a home and business phone service with an app and dashboard, so subscribing to call or SMS events via webhooks is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Missed-call alerts and voicemail-to-email are user notifications, not webhooks, and the probe found no OpenAPI or API surface at the candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
